current_evidence: The council's 'Local information requirements list for planning applications' download page (royalgreenwich.gov.uk/downloads/download/691) links only this PDF, whose title page reads 'Local Validation Requirements List - 2025' dated June 2025; nothing newer is linked.

issues.detail: List date 2025-07-01 is taken from the upload folder in the URL; the document itself is dated June 2025.
issues.evidence: Cover: 'Local Validation Requirements List - 2025', June 2025 (URL folder is 2025-07)

issues.detail: Many local requirements in the list are not captured at all: Accommodation Schedule (major residential); Affordable Housing Statement (10+ homes or 0.5ha+); Air Quality Positive Statement (GLA-referable schemes e.g. 150+ homes, 15,000 sqm+); Basement Impact Assessment (new or enlarged basements adjoining residential property); Biodiversity and Ecology Report (majors; new buildings/extensions/changes of use near designated sites or with habitat potential); BREEAM Pre-Assessment (major and all non-residential incl. extensions and change of use, major domestic refurbishment); Circular Economy Statement (GLA-referable majors); Designing Out Crime Statement (majors and ATMs); Delivery and Servicing Management Plan (majors and schemes generating significant deliveries); Digital Massing Model (majors); Green Infrastructure Assessment incl. Urban Greening Factor (majors); Materials Schedule (majors, new buildings, LBC, conservation areas); Parking Design and Management Plan (any scheme providing car parking); Views Analysis LVMF (sites in Landmark Viewing Corridors or backdrop of identified views); Fire Statement for non-majors (2+ dwellings / education buildings 18m+ or 7+ storeys, Planning Fire Safety Strategy or Reasonable Exception Statement).
issues.evidence: Local Information Requirements section, headings Accommodation Schedule through Views Analysis

issues.detail: Many trigger excerpts are just a heading plus 'When Required' with no trigger, or are text from the adjacent item. Examples: Air Quality Assessment ('Air Quality Assessment When Required' - source: all majors, minors with significant impact/exposure, plus traffic/combustion triggers); Flood Risk Assessment ('When required' only - source: 1ha+ in FZ1, all of FZ2/3 incl. householder extensions, surface water/sewer/groundwater flood areas); Transport Assessment (source: major residential 50+ units, major commercial, schools/hospitals etc.); Travel Plan, Marketing Report, Viability Assessment, Waste Management Strategy (source: all major residential and commercial) and Retail Statement (out-of-centre 2,500 sqm+ for impact) all lack triggers; Daylight/Sunlight (source: majors, tall buildings, backland/infill, adverse neighbour impact).
issues.evidence: e.g. 'Flood Risk Assessment When required' vs source trigger list under Flood Risk Assessment

issues.detail: Trigger text belongs to a different requirement: Economic Statement trigger is Digital Massing Model file-format text (FBX/OBJ, GBOS); Construction Management Plan trigger is 'Daylight/ Sunlight Assessment When Required'; Landscaping Strategy trigger is a BS 10175 contaminated land citation (source: majors, new open/play space, new dwellings with gardens, front gardens in CAs, listed building gardens); Planning Statement trigger is Energy Statement text (source: most applications except householder, flats, adverts, prior approvals, LDCs, DOCs); Statement of Community Involvement trigger is Sustainable Design and Construction text (source: majors); Open space/play space trigger is Air Quality Neutral text (source Play Space Strategy: major residential and communal play space); Schedule of works (listed building) and Structural Survey triggers are Basement Impact Assessment structural method statement text; Drainage Strategy/SuDS trigger is Foul Sewage and Utilities text (source SuDS: majors and sites over 0.25ha in surface water risk areas).
issues.evidence: e.g. 'Economic Statement if your modelling package does not geo-locate in GBOS...' (Digital Massing Model minimum requirements)

issues.detail: Design and Access Statement trigger is cut off mid-sentence and omits the conservation area / World Heritage Site trigger (one or more dwellings or 100 sqm+ floorspace in a CA or WHS). Accessibility Statement trigger carries stray 'LOCAL INFORMATION REQUIREMENTS 2024' header text. Lawful development evidence trigger 'Sworn affidavits The suggested information is not required to be provided' misstates the LDC requirement, which is that evidence of lawfulness IS required.
issues.evidence: LDC checklist: 'Required: ... evidence that the existing use or development is lawful'

issues.detail: The list has explicit checklists per application type but Grokbot recorded '(none)' or a single item for them: Advertisement consent '(none)' though the list requires existing elevations/photo, 1:20 advert drawings, 1:20 sections showing fixing/projection and illumination details; Lawful development cert '(none)' though evidence of lawfulness is required (LDC evidence was instead put under Full planning); Non-material amendment '(none)' though the S96a/S73 checklist requires a supporting statement, copies of approved plans and composite marked-up plans; Listed building consent lists only Heritage Impact Assessment though the LBC checklist also requires photographs, internal elevations 1:10/1:20, detail drawings 1:5, schedule of works and method statement, structural engineer's report, fire safety/sound proofing strategies and manufacturer specifications; Householder lists only plans/elevations though its checklist also requires heritage impact assessment, photographs, fire statement (minors), tree survey and FRA where relevant. Prior notification for larger home extensions and window-replacement / shopfront checklists are not captured.
issues.evidence: 'Requirements for Common Application Types' section of the 2025 list

issues.detail: CIL Additional Information form and existing/proposed sections are placed under 'Change of use - prior approval', but the source applies them to change-of-use planning applications generally (CIL: non-residential to residential change of use, 100 sqm+ net GIA or any new dwelling), not specifically to prior approvals. Separately, nearly all ~38 other requirements carry 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning' although the list gives scope by size/location (most are 'major' only, e.g. Health Impact Assessment, Energy Strategy, Fire Statement (Major)).
issues.evidence: CIL - 'When required - all applications proposing: a change of use from non-residential to residential'

issues.detail: Most of the 21 tab_items are process text, guidance or fragments, not requirements: validation team acknowledgement letters, neighbour letters, site notices and press adverts; duty planner / pre-application advice text (3 items); Planning Portal benefits blurb; email address for paper copies; 'RBG_Urban_Design_Guidance_Adopted (2).pdf When Required'; 'draft_guidance_sheet_fire_statements_d12_b_070720_web.pdf (london.gov.uk)'; a Digital Massing Model fragment labelled 'Economic Statement'; a Design and Access Statement heading fragment and a whole S96a/S73 checklist filed under 'Drawing / document standards'.
issues.evidence: e.g. 'The validation team process the application and send you an acknowledgment letter.'

issues.detail: Same excerpt reused for different requirements: Planning Statement and Energy Statement share 'Can be included within Planning Statement Energy Statement / Strategy When Required'; Schedule of works and Structural Survey both use Basement Impact Assessment text; Cycle parking and Parking provision both use 'car or cycle parking'; Economic Statement fragment appears in both tab_items and app_type_rows.
issues.evidence: app_type_rows for Planning Statement / Energy Statement

summary: Grokbot's link is the current Royal Greenwich Local Validation Requirements List 2025 (dated June 2025), but the extraction is poor: about 15 local requirements are missing, many triggers are blank or taken from neighbouring items, and the per-application-type checklists (adverts, LDC, LBC, S96a, householder) were largely missed.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
